treatment: Fresh current-main versus integrated PRD-source diagnostic. Identical full current-main kernel prefix; candidate restores main consumer headings. One fixed sample per arm; no retries.
acceptance: One fresh baseline and candidate: 6 PRD artifacts, 6 real contract consumptions and 8 decisions per arm. Strict raw, full policy delivery, native actual model/guidance and independent manual review of all outputs required before candidate launch. Check stated verifiable criteria, creative licence independent of admissibility, code blindness, canonical reasons, empty admissible reason and exactly one final contract. No new normalisation, waiver or retry. One-pair diagnostic with limited replication, not historical five-sample qualification or statistical equivalence.
